criteria.requirement: Fix iterutils.untyped_sorted so a supplied key is evaluated exactly once per input occurrence before comparisons, matching sorted key semantics. Preserve heterogeneous-type fallback order, stable equal keys, reverse and falsey callable support; validate noncallable keys, propagate key/comparison errors and leave input unchanged. Do not cache by object identity or return wrappers instead of original objects.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
